title: Residency Loyalty Reduction on Respite Re-Level Charges for Long-Standing Residents
content:
| Length of the guest's active Larkspur independent living residency | Residency loyalty reduction on the re-leveled nights |
|---|---|
| At least 60 whole months | 3 percent |
| At least 24 but fewer than 60 whole months | 1 percent |
| Fewer than 24 whole months, or no active residency | Nothing (0 percent) |

The residency loyalty reduction on the re-leveled nights of a level-change segment on an Assisted Living Respite Stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement is three percent where the guest's active Larkspur independent living residency began at least sixty whole months before the current date, one percent where it began at least twenty-four but fewer than sixty whole months before, and nothing otherwise.

The reduction is taken on the care increase billed per re-leveled night, by its percentage of that care increase as it stands: the amount is multiplied by 97 percent at 3 percent and by 99 percent at 1 percent.

The residency read is the guest's Independent Living Residency Agreement in active status; the whole months are counted from its move-in date to the current date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, current date 10 September 2026)

| Move-in date of the active residency | Whole months | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 10 September 2021 | 60 | 3 percent — exactly 60 counts |
| 11 September 2021 | 59 | 1 percent |
| 10 September 2024 | 24 | 1 percent — exactly 24 counts |
| 11 September 2024 | 23 | Nothing |

## Hypothetical illustration

With a care increase billed of 38.00 per re-leveled night as it stands and a residency that began 7 years ago, the reduction of 3 percent leaves 38.00 times 97 percent, that is 36.86 per re-leveled night before the segment's single rounding.
